QUOTE: Add the `MBEDTLS_ERR_<MODULE>_<NAME>` define in the module's header... Do not hand-edit the auto-generated cases in `library/error.c`. Regenerate them with `scripts/generate_errors.pl`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says to add the define to the module header and regenerate, but never says the define must be `/** */`-documented, and it says the description text's source is unverified. The item names that documentation comment as the mechanism, so the item isn't fully stated.
